doc.name: G — 30s rain-day comfort story set in a megacity night, high-energy in tone, a mascot character, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: rain-day comfort story set in a megacity night, high-energy in tone
Hero: a mascot character
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the rain-day comfort story set in a megacity night, high-energy in tone form, built around a mascot character.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. Keep the same time of day across all three acts unless the story's turn requires otherwise — and if it does, state the change explicitly.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a rack focus pulling from foreground occlusion to the subject in Act 1 against a vertigo/dolly-zoom counter-move holding the subject size constant in Act 3 — while holding the a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second rain-day comfort story set in a megacity night, high-energy in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same mascot character.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a boom-down from a high wide to a tight insert, shot on a 135mm telephoto at f/2.8, framed with a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a large overhead octabox with a black flag killing the floor bounce; grade as near-monochrome with a single accent hue allowed to stay saturated. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, and low quality.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distortion, low quality, warped text, extra limbs

config.negative_prompt: blur, distort, low quality, warped product label, unreadable logo

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second rain-day comfort story set in a megacity night, high-energy in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same mascot character.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a rack focus pulling from foreground occlusion to the subject, shot on a 45mm tilt-shift with the plane tipped at f/1.4, framed with a tight crop that breaks the subject at the frame edge.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a single 90cm softbox key at 45 degrees with a white bounce card for fill; grade as near-monochrome with a single accent hue allowed to stay saturated. OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

config.negative_prompt: blur, low quality, blown highlights, muddy shadows
